newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's new board member to be chief of personnel.
newsitem.headline: Buba's new board member to be chief of personnel.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday that Dieter Haferkamp, the newly appointed directorate member, will be in charge of personnel and a restructured currency department.

Haferkamp, appointed as the eighth member of the directorate effective December 1, replaces Gerd Haeusler. Haeusler resigned to join the board of Dresdner Bank, Germany's second largest commercial bank.
The 59-year-old banker was most recently the head of the Bundesbank's personnel department and joined the bank in 1968.

In a statement, the Bundesbank said its currency department will be restructured by February 1, 1997 and focus on controlling for market activities and settlement of currency and securities operations.
Currency trading operations will be assigned to the credit department, headed by Bundesbank vice-president Johann Wilhelm Gaddum.
